0022600141.text: The Utah Jazz (1-3) host the San Antonio Spurs (1-2) in the fifth game of the 2026-27 season, with the Jazz 13th in the West, on a two-game losing streak, and 1-2 at home. The Spurs have won their most recent game, sit 9th in the West, and are 0-2 at home, while Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), and Jaxson Hayes (shoulder soreness) and Lauri Markkanen (wrist) are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions. San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), and the teams have not met yet this season, though the Jazz lost 1-2 in the 2025-26 season series and most recently fell 126-109 at home to the Spurs on January 22, 2026.
